description.en: See which agent CLIs are installed on this Mac, your cmux servers and the team VM, their versions and sign-ins. Update, install and sign in with one tap; cmux runs the command in a terminal you can see.
description.ja: このMac、cmuxサーバー、チームVMにインストールされたエージェントCLI、そのバージョンとサインイン状態を表示します。更新、インストール、サインインはワンタップで、cmuxが見えるターミナルでコマンドを実行します。

scopes.machine:read: List this Mac, your cmux servers and the team VM.
scopes.agent_cli:read: See which agent CLIs are installed, their versions and whether they are signed in. Never a credential or an email.

optionalScopes.agent_cli:execute: Run a CLI's own update, install or sign-in command in a terminal you can see, only when you tap Update, Install or Sign In.
optionalScopes.actions:run: Open the cmux Accounts sign-in for Claude Code, Codex and others on this Mac.

title.ja: エージェントCLIの更新を確認
